notes.title: Ball Game Playtest!
notes.content:
[h1]Playtest Live now![/h1]

We are currently launching the game early using the Steam Playtest feature, this will allow us to receive feedback from more players. If you'd like to join just click the "Request Access" and we will get you in ASAP!

We'd love to hear from you, join our discord: https://discord.gg/fGr8DhMsNh
